viewmodel._portrait_tuning_note: Portrait entries are direct end values at portrait_aspect and blend from zero below 5:4. fov_offset adjusts horizontal viewmodel field of view in degrees (4:3 reference); offset is [forward, left, up] Source units. Higher FOV offsets make the weapon smaller. These portrait values restore the 97fac81 baseline; tune each profile directly without changing model scale. Current values: default/crowbar +8 degrees, physcannon 0, RPG +16; RPG left offset 4 units.
